lore_anchors.definition: A major rogue cultivator faction in the Chaotic Star Sea, formed to oppose the Star Palace. It is a loose coalition of powerful rogue cultivators and demonic sects.
A legendary Nascent Soul cultivator and the founder of a powerful lineage within the Rebellious Star Alliance. The “Six Paths” title refers to a ruthless and profound cultivation system.
A forbidden, Yin-aligned technique that attempts to forcefully reunite a departed soul with its body, defying the natural cycle of life and death. It carries a high risk of backlash.
A high-status mode of transport for powerful cultivators, consisting of a chariot carriage drawn by tamed high-grade demon beasts.
An advanced flying sword technique that allows a swordsman to multiply their flying swords, creating a storm of illusory blades from a single true sword.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Rebellious Star Alliance?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a major anti-establishment faction in the Chaotic Star Sea, formed by rogue cultivators and demonic sects who oppose the dominant Star Palace.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Wen Tianren attack Han Li immediately?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was already on the island drawn by the unusual celestial energy, and upon finding Han Li, he issued a formal recruitment ultimatum—join or die—which is standard operating procedure for powerful faction princes.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Soul Reunion Art?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a forbidden, Yin-aligned ritual that attempts to forcefully drag a departed soul back into its body, defying the natural order and creating heavy Yin energy visible as a celestial phenomenon.
